$comment: EXP-1601/1603: the motion eval corpus. Each prompt is answered twice (variant `dialect` with guide.md, variant `lottie` with lottie-guide.md) by the same model; tests/eval.rs scores the recorded replies (valid = parses, compiles/validates, loads, draws something mid-animation). CI replays fixtures and never calls a model.

prompts.prompt: A loading spinner: a circular arc that rotates continuously, 48×48.
A success checkmark that draws itself inside a circle, then stays, 64×64.
A live indicator: a small dot with a ring that pulses outward and fades, looping, 32×32.
A ball bouncing on the floor with squash on impact and a shadow that scales, 200×200.
A progress ring that fills from 0 to 75% over one second, 80×80.
A heart that beats twice and rests, looping, 64×64.
Three typing-indicator dots that rise and fall one after another, 60×20.
A celebration burst: eight small coloured pieces fly out from the centre and fade, 200×200.
A smooth wave line that ripples left to right, looping, 240×60.
A gear icon rotating slowly, 64×64.
A sun with rays that grow and shrink while the sun rotates, 120×120.
A toggle switch knob sliding from off to on while the track changes colour, 64×36.
A notification bell that shakes left and right then settles, 64×64.
An upload arrow that moves up out of a tray and reappears from below, looping, 64×64.
A square that morphs into a circle and back while changing colour, 120×120.
A radar screen with a sweeping beam and a blip that appears, 160×160.
A skeleton placeholder: three grey bars with a light shimmer passing across, 240×80.
A rocket that shakes, then launches up and out of the frame with a flame, 120×200.
A clock face whose minute hand goes all the way round while the hour hand moves one step, 100×100.
A battery icon charging: the level fills in three steps, looping, 80×40.
A wifi icon whose three arcs light up one after another, 64×64.
A music equalizer with five bars moving up and down at different speeds, 80×60.
A round smiley face that blinks once every two seconds, 80×80.
Three stars that twinkle (scale and fade) at different times, 160×100.
A cloud with rain drops falling from it, looping, 120×120.
An error state: a red circle pops in and an X draws itself inside, 64×64.
An envelope whose flap opens and a letter slides up out of it, 120×100.
A coin spinning around its vertical axis (squash horizontally to fake 3D), 80×80.
A logo reveal: the word shape is uncovered by a circle that grows from the centre (use a mask or matte), 240×120.
A card that slides up and fades in, with a title bar and two text lines appearing after it, using the theme colours, 200×140.
